verification.spec: Provide a synthetic p_i(t) curve with a known analytic integral (e.g., constant p_i(t)=0.5 over the interval) and assert AUC_i returned by the implementation equals 0.5 within 1e-6. Also test a linear ramp p_i(t)=t/Delta for AUC_i=0.5.

sub_tasks.requirements: The area under the baseline success curve ($\mathrm{AUC}_i^b=\frac{1}{\Delta} \int_0^{\Delta} p_i^b(t) \mathrm{d} t$) for each task is computed, as described in Equation (2) of Section 5.1.

sub_tasks.requirements: The reference forward transfer metric has been implemented, as described in Section 5.1 -- "Reference Forward Transfer".
